scope: Cover deep enum-domain scalar parameter inference with a same-named enum shadowing search_path
engine: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine in Docker via testcontainers
contract: The fixture creates a 64-level domain-over-enum chain and a same-named shadow enum with an additional label, then puts the shadow schema first on the transaction search_path.

At domain depths 63 and 64, COALESCE and CASE expressions compare bound text, literal NULL text, empty text and SQL NULL against native untyped-literal inference. The test checks exact result labels, parameter enum type, expression result type and declared domain type.
This proves only the two named scalar contexts at these depths under this shadowed search_path configuration; it does not establish broader session or parameter-context coverage.

focused_test.command: rtk cargo test --offline --locked --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_deep_enum_scalar_contexts_resolve_under_shadowed_search_path -- --ignored --test-threads=1

remaining: Other PostgreSQL session/search_path combinations, deep parameter contexts, consumers, native types and the broader B3 matrix remain open; this case does not qualify 0.2.0.
